description: This file defines a Java interface 'InitializationDatabase' which declares methods related to initializing or populating a database, including checking if the database is empty and populating it with data.

classes.name: InitializationDatabase
classes.description: A Java interface defining methods for database initialization tasks, such as checking if the database is empty and populating it with data.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the database is empty. Returns true if empty.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the database with data identified by the provided name. May throw ServiceException.
